17172	def _neighbour_estimate(seeds: List[Dict[str, Any]],
17173	                        dims: List[Dict[str, Any]],
17174	                        is_feasible: Callable[[Dict[str, Any]], bool]):
17175	    """Estimate the refine-stage trial count (best-effort, for progress bar)."""
17176	    seen = set()
17177	    for s in seeds:
17178	        base = {k: (tuple(v) if isinstance(v, list) else v)
17179	                for k, v in s["config"].items()}
17180	        for d in dims:
17181	            for nb in _step_neighbours(base.get(d["name"]), d["values"], 2):
17182	                cfg = dict(base)
17183	                cfg[d["name"]] = nb
17184	                k = config_key(cfg)
17185	                if k in seen or not is_feasible(cfg):
17186	                    continue
17187	                seen.add(k)
17188	                yield cfg
